title: feat(pm): pm:mailbox label and the mailbox-open.mjs opener/closer (#25417)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DCMDFdvcggLAgVyfdkyY9Mj)_

Fixes #25417

Dispatched by the `domain:devx` seat 1 (#6023); Claim on #25417 names `claude/project-thread-9gk9rn`.

## What changed

- **`scripts/pm/ensure-pm-labels.sh`**: `pm:mailbox` in the five-repo loop (objectstack, objectui, cloud, objectos, hotcrm). Description, 92 chars: *A project's cross-account mailbox PR — never merged, owes no CI, excluded from every ledger*. `check:pm-label-desc-cap` green (42 descriptions, all ≤100).
- **`scripts/pm/mailbox-open.mjs`** (new):
  - `--repo <slug> --login <login>`: ① reads the open pulls and refuses (exit 4) if an open `pm:mailbox` PR already belongs to that login (head `mailbox/<login>` or body line `Mailbox-of: <login>`); ② builds one empty commit on `origin/<base>` with `git commit-tree` (no checkout, index or working tree touched) and pushes it as `mailbox/<login>` through `with-fleet.sh --kind 'git push'`; ③ sends one relay stroke, `pr_create` labelled `pm:mailbox` + `skip-changeset` (draft is forced by the relay); ④ reads the number back off the head and prints it for `subscribe_pr_activity`.
  - `--head <branch>` uses an existing branch instead of pushing (refuses unless it is ahead of base). This is the route for a cloud seat, because the relay has no ref-creating op and with-fleet refuses a push there.
  - `--close <n>` reads the pull first and refuses anything but an open `pm:mailbox` PR, then sends `comment` + `issue_patch state: closed` in one stroke.
  - `--dry-run` is offline (no read, no git, no dispatch) and prints the actions file after the relay's own `validateStroke` has judged it.
  - Exports `LEDGER_EXCLUSION = '-label:pm:mailbox'` for ledger readers to import (the roster card #25416 and any future landing query).

## Ledger exclusion: what the grep found

`git grep -n 'head:claude/' scripts/pm` → **0 hits**, and no script under `scripts/pm/` enumerates open PRs for landing today. The only `head:claude/` reader is prose in `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/landing-operations.md` L26. That file is `.claude/**`, outside this card, and belongs to the sibling skills card for the mailbox protocol. `board-snapshot.mjs` lists every open pull, but only for its archive count check (`open_issues_count` minus open pulls), and there a mailbox **must** be counted. So it is deliberately left unchanged.

## CI exemption

`Check Changeset` was the check measured red on #25392's empty diff, and the `changeset-check` job already skips wholesale on `skip-changeset`, which the opener applies. Any other red on a mailbox is declared **red by design** in the body the script writes, so a subscribed thread reads the exemption on the PR itself.

## Not done here, on purpose

- The self-test is **not wired into `lint.yml`**. Adding a `check:pm-mailbox-open` step touches `.github/workflows/**`, which flips this PR to Tier H and is outside the dispatched file surface. `check:self-test-wired` stays green without it, because CI does not run the script. Wiring it is a one-step follow-up if the seat wants it.
- The script is written here and never run: pushing `mailbox/<login>` is outside this session.

## Verification

- `node scripts/pm/mailbox-open.mjs --self-test` → `✓ 40 cases in 7 batteries pass` (battery roster, floor and verdict handshake per AGENTS.md).
- `node scripts/pm/mailbox-open.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --login os-elon-musk --dry-run` prints the plan and the actions file, exit 0. That file fed to `fleet-write/dispatch.mjs --dry-run` packs without refusal.
- `check-governed-merges.mjs --test scripts/pm/mailbox-open.mjs scripts/pm/ensure-pm-labels.sh` → NOT governed (Tier S).
- `check-self-test-wired`, `check-step-collectors`, `check-workflow-status-functions` → exit 0.

No changeset: scripts-only, publishes nothing (`skip-changeset`).
